stem.text: Element W is in period three of the Periodic Table and has a solid, white oxide, X. X is thermally stable and has a very high melting point.
X is slightly soluble in water.
Which row describes the structure and bonding of X?

B.text: strong double bonds within small molecules; covalent

D.text: strong ionic bonds within small molecules; ionic

B:
strong double bonds
within small molecules
D:
strong ionic bonds
within small molecules
